name: hardcoded-color
description: Inline colour literals — bg-[#hex], text-[#hex], stroke-[hsl(...)], style={{ color: '#...' }}. Surfaces every site so the agent can replace with a semantic token or open a system gap.

anyOf.reason: Arbitrary background colour — map to a semantic token (bg-accent, bg-surface-raised, …).
Arbitrary text colour — map to text-text, text-text-muted, etc.
Arbitrary border colour — map to border-border-subtle / border-border-strong.
Arbitrary fill — map to a semantic token.
Arbitrary stroke — map to a semantic token.
